content: We used Bi-directional LSTM to capture the word representation in forward as well as reverse direction of a sentence. Generally, LSTMs take inputs from left (past) of the sentence and computes the hidden state. However, it is proven beneficialBIBREF23 to use bi-directional LSTM, where, hidden states are computed based from right (future) of sentence and both of these hidden states are concatenated to produce the final output as $h_t$=[$\overrightarrow{h_t}$;$\overleftarrow{h_t}$], where $\overrightarrow{h_t}$, $\overleftarrow{h_t}$ = hidden state computed in forward and backward direction respectively.
